_help.tipSeconds: How long a tutorial callout stays up before it fades, unless you tap it. Try 6–10.
_help.selfTangleBy: Sprout (the tutorial game's AI) starts preferring moves that walk ONE of its glyphlings into a pocket — next to your pieces when it can, so you see the tangle bonus — from this turn of its own. Lower = it happens sooner. A preference, never a rule: if the board offers no pocket, it doesn't happen. Try 4–8.
_help.sproutSlowdown: The tutorial game: Sprout's pauses (its think before each move, its hold on its aim before the throw) are this many times longer than Settings → AI speed says, so a new player can follow what it does. 2 = half speed. 1 = like any AI. Try 1.5–3.
_help.railsCalloutDelay: The tutorial game's first 2 turns: how long after the game goes quiet (a glide, a seed landing, the score) the next callout shows. Lower = snappier, higher = calmer. Try 0.3–1.2.
_help.railsDim: How dark a tutorial pause (Got it / Play) makes the rest of the game. 0 = not at all, 1 = black. Try 0.5–0.75. The 3 pausing tips (tangled ×2, one to go) use it too.
_help.tipDelay: A first-time tip (after the first 2 turns, and in later games while Settings → Tips is on) shows this long after the game goes quiet. Try 0.3–1.2.
_help.tipsPerTurn: At most this many first-time tips in one turn — the rest wait for a later turn. 1 keeps it calm.
_help.maxPauses: At most this many PAUSING tips (they dim the game and wait for Got it) in one game; past it, a pausing tip shows like a normal one. Online games never pause.
_help.idleGlow: The tutorial game: seconds of doing nothing on your turn before the right thing glows (breathes like the whose-turn pulse). Try 4–12.
_help.idleText: The tutorial game: seconds of doing nothing before a callout says what you can do. Try 8–25 (more than the glow).
_help.idleRepeat: How many times each idle callout (place / move / plant / Plant / refresh) may show in one game, then it stays quiet. Try 2–5.
_help.laterIdleText: Later games on this device (Tips on): seconds of doing nothing before the idle callout — no glow there. Online games use onlineIdleText. Try 20–60.
_help.onlineIdleText: Online games (Tips on): seconds of doing nothing before the idle callout. Keep it below the room's "Still there?" bar (content/rooms.json idleWarnAfterMs, 30 s) — while that bar is up, or a bot plays for you, no idle callout shows. Try 10–25.
_help.wrongRepeat: After the first 2 turns: how many times each 'wrong action' callout (a seed before moving, a bad drop, a rival's glyphling…) may show in one game; then only the 'no' shake. On the first 2 turns it shows every time. Try 2–5.
_help.calloutRoom: How much room a tip needs above its target before the turn bar / ☰; with less, it goes below (a pause near the board's top covered ☰ on a phone). In px (a tip with a button is ~160 tall). Try 150–240.
_help.exploreRemind: Explore mode (the ? button): after this many seconds with no tap, the reminder "Tap ? to go back to the game" shows again at the ?. Try 10–30.
_help.exploreDim: Explore mode: how dark everything but the tapped thing goes while its callout is up. 0 = not at all, 1 = black. Try 0.3–0.6.
